agent.final_text:
I fixed the bug in `build_format_selector` in `youtube_dl/YoutubeDL.py`. After the change, `test_youtube_format_selection` passes and so does the rest of `test/test_YoutubeDL.py` (14 tests).

When the parser hit a `/`, it added the choice to the list of selectors and set `current_selector` to `None`. A later `,` (as in `a/b,c`) then added that `None` to the list, which caused the `AttributeError` when the selector function was built.

The `/` branch now stores the choice in `current_selector` instead, so it is added to the list in the normal way.
